name_zh: 约旦·阿卜杜拉二世：哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平与水难民危机
name_en: Jordan Abdullah II: Hashemite Palestine Peace & Water Refugee Crisis
description_zh: 阿卜杜拉二世 (1962-) 约旦国王 (1999-)，哈希姆王朝守护耶路撒冷圣地，1994约旦以色列和平条约，巴勒斯坦难民占人口60%水资源极度匮乏，平衡美以巴三方博弈。
description_en: Abdullah II (1962-) Jordan King (1999-), Hashemite dynasty guards Jerusalem holy sites, 1994 Jordan-Israel peace treaty, Palestinian refugees 60% population water extremely scarce, balances US-Israel-Palestine three-way game.
reason_zh: 阿卜杜拉代表哈希姆王朝如何在巴以冲突核心地带通过和平条约与圣地监护维持合法性，展示了水资源匮乏与难民负担如何成为小国生存的硬约束，其平衡外交为地区稳定提供关键缓冲。
reason_en: Abdullah represents how Hashemite dynasty maintains legitimacy in Israel-Palestine conflict core through peace treaty and holy site guardianship, demonstrating how water scarcity and refugee burden become small state survival hard constraints, his balancing diplomacy providing critical buffer for regional stability.
steps_zh: 研究阿卜杜拉早年英国军校与王储准备
分析1994年瓦迪阿拉巴和平条约与圣地监护权
探讨巴勒斯坦难民安置与水资源危机管理
评估阿拉伯春天约旦稳定与叙利亚难民涌入
总结哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平水难民对约旦生存空间的界定
steps_en: Study Abdullah early British military academy and crown prince preparation
Analyze 1994 Wadi Araba peace treaty and holy site guardianship
Explore Palestinian refugee settlement and water crisis management
Evaluate Arab Spring Jordan stability and Syrian refugee influx
Summarize Hashemite Palestine peace water refugee defining Jordan survival space
expected_zh: 掌握哈希姆圣地监护与和平条约双重合法性来源，理解水难民双重危机如何重塑小国外交自主边界，评估约旦模式对黎巴嫩巴勒斯坦权力机构的示范与差异。
expected_en: Master Hashemite holy guardianship and peace treaty dual legitimacy sources, grasp how water-refugee dual crisis reshapes small state diplomatic autonomy boundaries, evaluate Jordan model demonstration and divergence for Lebanon Palestinian Authority.
case_zh: 1999 国王；1994 和平；水危机；难民60%。哈希姆巴勒斯坦和平水难民范式永存。
case_en: 1999 King; 1994 peace; water crisis; refugees 60%. Hashemite Palestine peace water refugee paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Hashemite Monarchy / Peace Process / Water Diplomacy
cross_cultural_impact: Peace treaty; holy sites; Palestinian refugees; water diplomacy
